summary: Original St. Joe NF tower (1954, L-4 cab) was gone by 1995. A 1959 Washington tower moved to nearby Crystal Ridge in 1983 is now a private rental.

facts.design: 41-foot treated timber tower with L-4 cab, built 1954; a 1930s crow's nest stood on the peak before it
facts.status_note: Gone by 1995 per firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the FFLA list. A separate 1959 tower, moved from Washington, stands on private land at nearby Crystal Ridge.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wander in RAW and the FFLA list (Stranger Mtn, WA) give Washington; lookouttowers.org gives the Idaho DNR. The story follows the Washington origin and says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: Two structures share the Crystal Peak name. The 1954 St. Joe tower is this record. The 1959 tower at Fernwood is listed separately by the FFLA as Crystal Ridge, and no source I read ties it to the 1954 tower; its build year differs. Consider a separate record for the relocated tower rather than merging. lookouttowers.org's own footer credits a deep-research draft, so it carries low weight and is cited only for the disputed origin and the rental use. The staffing entry is Barbara Nelson, 1967; a second name, Neil Nelson, carries a Kellogg Evening News note under the same heading and may be a source credit rather than a staff entry. The two Crystal Peak coordinates are about 1.5 km apart (computed from the FFLA figures). No photo added. Inhabitat and Small Home Tours appeared in search results only and are not cited.
